title: sonnen’s new smart breakers help your home battery last longer
summary:
A home battery can do more during a blackout if it isn’t busy running nonessential, energy-hungry appliances. sonnen and SOLRITE Energy are putting that same principle to work for the grid, adding smart breakers that can temporarily switch off selected household loads while batteries help meet electricity demand.

title: Lunar’s new home DC fast charger puts your EV battery to work
summary:
Lunar Energy has unveiled a 25-kW home DC fast charger that will do more than just power up your car really fast. Paired with its next-generation home battery system, the Lunar Fast Charger will also let a compatible EV help keep the house running during an outage and potentially earn money by sending electricity back to the grid.

title: SpaceX could announce $1.5 trillion Tesla merger in December: report
summary:
Elon Musk’s companies are moving faster than expected on a Tesla-SpaceX combination. A deal could be announced as soon as December, which would make it the largest merger ever, according to Bloomberg.

Tesla holds its annual shareholder meeting on December 3, and the same directors who would sign off on the deal are up for re-election.

title: Police charge another Tesla driver caught asleep in rush hour as cases pile up
summary:
A Tesla driver caught asleep behind the wheel on Ottawa’s Highway 417 during Tuesday’s rush hour now faces a careless driving charge from the Ontario Provincial Police. The photo OPP shared shows a new-generation Model Y in traffic.

The charge carries a $490 fine and six demerit points on conviction. It’s at least the fifth time this year Canadian police have gone public with a sleeping Tesla driver, and it’s not a coincidence that it’s happening as “Full Self-Driving” gets better.
